verses.sanskrit:
नारद उवाच।
              कर्णस्तु समवाप्यैवमस्त्रं भार्गवनन्दनात् । दुर्योधनेन सहितो मुमुदे भरतर्षभ ॥१॥
verses.english: Yudhishthira said If any person, desirous of accomplishing acts of charity and sacrifices, fails to find (the necessary) wealth, and thirst of wealth gets the better of him, what course should he pursue to obtain happiness?

verses.sanskrit: ततः कदाचिद्राजानः समाजग्मुः स्वयंवरे । कलिङ्गविषये राजन् राज्ञश्चित्राङ्गदस्य च ॥२॥
verses.english: He who makes no difference between two opposite agents, viz., pleasure and pain, honour and insult, etc., who never troubles himself for the gratification of his desire for worldly possessions, who observes veracity of speech, who has freed himself from all kinds of attachment, and who has renounced his desire for action, is, O Bharata, a happy man.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमद्राजपुरं नाम नगरं तत्र भारत । राजानः शतशस्तत्र कन्यार्थे समुपागमन् ॥३॥
verses.english: The ancients say these are the five means by which perfect tranquility or emancipation could be obtained. These are called Heaven. These are Religion. These form the highest happiness.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा दुर्योधनस्तत्र समेतान् सर्वपार्थिवान् । रथेन काञ्चनाङ्गेन कर्णेन सहितो ययौ ॥४॥
verses.english: Regarding it is cited the old story of what Manki had sung, when freed from attachments. Hear it, O Yudhishthira.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स्वयंवरे तस्मिन्संप्रवृत्ते महोत्सव । समाजग्मुर्नृपतयः कन्याथ नृपसत्तम ॥५॥
verses.english: Manki, desirous of wealth, found that he was doomed to an unending series of disappointinents. With a little remnant of his property hc purchased at last a couple of young bulls with a yoke for training them (to pastoral labour).

verses.sanskrit: शिशुपालो जरासन्धो भीष्मको वक्र एव च । कपोतरोमा नीलश्च रुक्मी च दृढविक्रमः ॥६॥
verses.english: One day the two bulls, properly yoked, were taken out for training (in the fields). Shying at the sight of a camel which was lying down on the road, the animals suddenly ran towards the camel, and fell upon its neck. Enraged at finding the bulls fall upon its neck, the camel, possessed of great speed, got up and ran with full speed, bearing away the two helpless creatures dangling on either side of its neck.

verses.sanskrit: सृगालश्च महाराजः स्त्रीराज्याधिपतिश्च यः। अशोकः शतधन्वा च भोजो वीरश्च नामतः ॥७॥
एते चान्ये च बहवो दक्षिणां दिशमाश्रिताः । म्लेच्छाचार्याश्च राजानः प्राच्योदीच्यास्तथैव च ॥८॥
verses.english: Beholding his two bulls thus carried away by the strong camel, and seeing that they were: on the point of death, Manki began to say,-If it is not ordained by destiny, wealth can never be obtained even by a clever man strenuously and confidently striving and skilfully doing all that is necessary towards the accomplishment of his object.

verses.sanskrit: काञ्चनाङ्गदिनः सर्वे शुद्धजाम्बूनदप्रभाः । सर्वे भास्वरदेहाश्च व्याघ्रा इव बलोत्कटाः ॥९॥
verses.english: I had, all along, tried by all manner and means, and with great devotion, to acquire riches. But all this misfortune to my property is due to Destiny.

verses.sanskrit: ततः समुपविष्टेषु तेषु राजसु भारत । विवेश रंगं सा कन्या धात्री वर्षवरान्विता ॥१०॥
verses.english: My bulls are carried away, rising and falling, as the camel is running in the uneven course. This event seems to be an accident like the one brought about by the crow to a ripe fruit while perching on a palmyra free.

verses.sanskrit: ततः संश्राव्यमाणेषु राज्ञां नामसु भारत । अत्यक्रामद्धार्तराष्ट्रं सा कन्या वरवर्णिी ॥११॥
verses.english: Alas, those dear bulls of mine are dangling on the camel's neck like a couple of gems! This is the result of Destiny alone. Exertion is of no avail in what is due to Chance.

verses.sanskrit: दुर्योधनस्तु कौरव्यो नामर्षयत लङ्घनम् । प्रत्यषेधच्च तां कन्यामसत्कृत्य नराधिपान् ॥१२॥
verses.english: Or, if the existence of anything like Exertion (as a resulting factor) be admitted, a little more scrutiny would find that Destiny is at the bottom.

verses.sanskrit: स वीर्यमदमत्तत्वाद्भीष्मद्रोणावुपाश्रितः । रथमारोप्य तां कन्यामाजहार नराधिपः ॥१३॥
verses.english: Therefore, he who is desirous of happiness, should renounce all attachment. He who is indifferent to worldly surroundings, has renounced all desires for acquiring wealth, can sleep happily.

verses.sanskrit: तमन्वगाद्रथी खड्गी बद्धगोधाङ्गुलित्रवान् । कर्णः शस्त्रभृतां श्रेष्ठः पृष्ठतः पुरुषर्षभ ॥१४॥
verses.english: He, it was well-said by Shuka while going to the great forest from his father's house, renouncing everything.

verses.sanskrit: ततो विमर्दः सुमहान् राज्ञामासीद्युयुत्सताम् । सन्नह्यतां तनुत्राणि रथान्योजयतामपि ॥१५॥
verses.english: Amongst these two, viz., one who obtains the fruition of all his desires, and one who renounces all desires, the latter, who casts off everything is superior to the first who obtains the fruition of all his desires.

verses.sanskrit: तेऽभ्यधावन्त संक्रुद्धाः कर्णदुर्योधनावुभौ । शरवर्षाणि मुञ्चन्तो मेघाः पर्वतयोरिव ॥१६॥
verses.english: No one could ever attain to the end of desire. Only he who is destitute of knowledge and judgement feels and avidity for protecting his body and life.

verses.sanskrit: कर्णस्तेषामापततामेकैकेन शरेण ह । धनूंषि च शरव्रातान्पातयामास भूतले ॥१७॥
verses.english: Renounce all desire for action. O my Soul which has become a prey of cupidity, adopt tranquillity by freeling yourself from all worldly attachments. Repeatedly have you been cheated (by phantomis of hope). How is it that you do not still free yourself from attachments?

verses.sanskrit: तता विधनुषः कांश्चित् कांश्चिदुद्यतकार्मुकान् । कांश्चिच्चोद्वहतो बाणान् रथ-शक्ति-गदास्तथा ॥१८॥
verses.english: If I am not one who deserves to be crushed by you, if I am one with whom you should play in delight, then, O my wealth-coveting Soul, do not induce me towards cupidity.

verses.sanskrit: लाघवाद्व्याकुलीकृत्य कर्णः प्रहरतां वरः । हतसूतांश्च भूयिष्ठानवजिग्ये नराधिपान् ॥१९॥
verses.english: You have now and again lost your hoarded wealth! O my wealth-covering and foolish Soul, when will you succeed in getting rid of your desire for wealth?

verses.sanskrit: त स्वयं वाहयन्तोऽश्वान् पाहि पाहीति वादिनः । व्यपेयुस्ते रणं हित्वा राजानो भग्नमानसाः ॥२०॥
verses.english: Shame on my foolishness. I have become a toy of yours. It is thus that one becomes a slave of others.

verses.sanskrit: दुर्योधनस्तु कर्णेन पाल्यमानोऽभ्ययात्तदा । हृष्टः कन्यामुपादाय नगरं नागसाह्वयम् ॥२१॥
verses.english: No one born on Earth did ever attain to the end of desire, and no one who will be born hereafter will succeed in attaining to it. Renouncing all acts, I have at last been roused from sleep. I am now awake.
